prompt_text: Who does backflow testing and repair near Liberty MO?
answer_verbatim:
I don’t have live web access to look up current businesses, so I can’t give a real‑time list of companies. I can, however, tell you the best ways to find qualified backflow testers/repair technicians near Liberty, MO and what to ask so you hire the right person.

Where to look
- Search Google Maps or Yelp for “backflow testing,” “backflow tester,” “backflow repair,” or “cross‑connection testing” + “Liberty, MO” (or “Kansas City metro”).  
- Call the City of Liberty Water/Public Works department — many utilities maintain a list of approved or certified testers or can tell you certificate requirements.  
- Check local plumbing and irrigation companies (they often provide testing/repairs). Big national services (Roto‑Rooter, Mr. Rooter) also commonly do backflow testing.  
- State/local resources: look for Missouri cross‑connection/backflow control program pages or the county water district for requirements and certified tester lists.

What to verify with any tester
- Certification: ask for their tester certification (commonly ASSE 5110 or a state/local tester certificate).  
- License & insurance: a current plumbing license (if required locally) and general liability insurance.  
- Experience: number/type of assemblies tested (residential vs commercial).  
- Documentation: they must provide a test report and tag the assembly afterward; many utilities require an online or mailed test report.  
- Price & availability: ask for a written quote for testing and for repair work (some charge separate service/travel fees).

Typical costs (ballpark)
- Annual test (residential/simple assemblies): roughly $50–$150.  
- Repairs: small repairs $100–$300; major parts or assembly replacement can range several hundred to over $1,000 depending on the device and complexity. Get a written estimate.

What I can do next
- If you want, tell me whether this is residential or commercial and any ZIP code, and I’ll provide a short script/email you can use to contact local companies or a checklist to compare quotes.  
- If you want me to look up specific businesses, I can do that if you can allow me to access the web (note: I don’t currently have browsing enabled in this chat).
